paper.title: Designing an Interactive Visual Analytics System for Precipitation Data Analysis

evidence.paraphrase: Designs an interactive visual analytics system with coordinated views for hourly precipitation across U.S. states, supporting temporal, spatial and statistical pattern analysis.
Links a visual-analytic method directly to empirical precipitation evidence (intensity, duration, frequency) via storm case studies.
The contribution is the VA system rather than rainfall-pattern findings, and the data are U.S. stations rather than Bangkok.

reviews.rationale: The paper connects a visual-analytics method to empirical precipitation evidence, which is the defining purpose of method_evidence_bridge; rainfall_pattern_evidence captures only its data side. It is in scope as method-to-evidence context, but the group label should probably be method_evidence_bridge.
